entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="静かに過ごしたいだけだよ" t="I just want some peace and quiet." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="静かに過ごしたいだけだよ" t="Vreau doar puțină liniște." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="おい！" t="Hey!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="おい！" t="Hei!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="やめろ" t="Stop it." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="やめろ" t="Oprește-te!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="はい？" t="Yes?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="はい？" t="Da?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="何か特別なものにしたいですね…" t="I want it to be something really special..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="何か特別なものにしたいですね…" t="Vreau să fie ceva special..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ふむ… そういうのなら持ってたかもしれません… 古い漫画はみんな欲しがりますから…" t="Hmm... I think I have something like that... People always want old comics..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ふむ… そういうのなら持ってたかもしれません… 古い漫画はみんな欲しがりますから…" t="Hmm... Cred că am ceva de genul ăsta... Oamenii vor mereu benzi desenate vechi..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="いえ、こちらこそありがとうございます" t="No, thank you!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="いえ、こちらこそありがとうございます" t="Nu, mulțumesc!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="みんな！ 逃げろ！" t="Everyone! Run!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="みんな！ 逃げろ！" t="Toată lumea! Fugiți!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="やめてくれ！ お願いだ！" t="No, no, no! Please!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="やめてくれ！ お願いだ！" t="Nu, nu, nu! Te rog!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="勘弁してくれ！" t="Mercy!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="勘弁してくれ！" t="Îndurare!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="頼む！ 何もしてないだろ！" t="Please! I have done nothing to you!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="頼む！ 何もしてないだろ！" t="Te rog! Nu ți-am făcut nimic!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="とにかく放っといてくれ！" t="Just leave me alone, please!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="とにかく放っといてくれ！" t="Lasă-mă în pace, te rog!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="何がしたいんだ？" t="What do you want?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="何がしたいんだ？" t="Ce vrei?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="本ですか、いいですね！ 100年、いや200年前の古いものを見つければ… ええ…" t="A book, of course! Maybe one hundred, even two hundred years old... Mh-hm..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="本ですか、いいですね！ 100年、いや200年前の古いものを見つければ… ええ…" t="Sigur, o carte! Poate de o sută, chiar două sute de ani... Mh-hm..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="奥様、家に帰って調べてみて、それから連絡を差し上げますよ。それでよろしいですか？" t="Ma'am, let me go home and check first, and then I'll call you, OK?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="奥様、家に帰って調べてみて、それから連絡を差し上げますよ。それでよろしいですか？" t="Doamnă, mă duc acasă să verific întâi, apoi vă sun, OK?" b="" a=""/>
